canonical_project: Praia cable landing stations (EllaLink branch, WACS, SHARE, CVT domestic, Atlantis-2)
owner: Cabo Verde Telecom (EllaLink branch + domestic inter-island cable); WACS/SHARE consortia; Atlantis-2 consortium
notes: Sotavento / Santiago / Praia. CONNECTIVITY INFRASTRUCTURE - NOT a data centre (no server/hosting/colo evidence promoted per methodology). EIB agreed US$25M (2019) for CVTelecom's EllaLink connection as part of a US$60M CVT programme (4G, FTTH, solar); DCD 2022-09-13 (cited in methodology, checked 2026-08-12) lists EllaLink branch, WACS, SHARE and CVT domestic cable at Praia; legacy Atlantis-2 (RFS 2000) reported disconnected Jan 2022. Landing stations may host PoP equipment only.
